premises.text: Traditional social streams are too noisy for busy people to find what they care about
premises.evidence_span: Oftentimes, the stuff that we most care about gets lost in stuff like this

premises.text: Undrip community excludes status/check-ins/games and focuses on link gems with social context
premises.evidence_span: Sort of like a path, but for links

premises.text: Ingests connected networks and ranks content using habits, relationships, and popularity without explicit interest setup
premises.evidence_span: The beauty of UNDRIP is I didn't have to say, I'm interested in this, this, this, and this. I didn't have to say, these are my circles of friends who I care about most. It's all implicit

premises.text: Interactions return to originating networks; users drip-reshare and can follow tastemakers into their feed mix
premises.evidence_span: I can interact, and all the interactions will go back to the originating social networks

premises.text: Ships as mobile apps on iPhone and iPad
premises.evidence_span: We're on the iPhone. We're on the iPad. We're in the App Store

value.text: Mobile community to discover and share web gems with relevance and serendipity
value.evidence_span: helps you discover and share the gems of the web
